# Tennis Coach Riviera — llms.txt
# https://tenniscoachriviera.com/
# Last updated: 2026-10-08

## About

Tennis Coach Riviera is a private tennis coaching service on the French Riviera (Côte d'Azur), run by Massimo Bettini. Lessons take place on the client's own court (private villa, residence or hotel). For clients without a private court, a suitable option is arranged case by case. Lessons are available in French, English and Italian with the same coach.

## Coach

- Name: Massimo Bettini
- Certification: FITP IS1 and IS2 (Italian Tennis and Padel Federation, 2nd level)
- Teaching experience: 10 years, including at Tennis Palladio 98, Vicenza (Italy)
- ATP Challenger: operations coordinator for the organisation of the Internazionali di Tennis Città di Vicenza (2023–2026)
- Languages: French, English, Italian
- Based in: Nice, Alpes-Maritimes, France

## Services

- Private tennis lessons on the client's court (villa, residence, hotel)
- Adults, beginners, seniors
- Children and juniors
- Family sessions (several levels, one coach)
- Lessons for two or three players of a similar level
- Single or regular lessons
- Private lessons for hotel and concierge guests

## Service Areas

Nice, Monaco, Cap Ferrat, Beaulieu-sur-Mer, Èze, Menton, Antibes, Juan-les-Pins, Cannes, Mougins, Biot, Valbonne, Sophia Antipolis
